						16 Nov 2026					
				

				EU countries announce plans for a migrant hub in Rwanda to tackle illegal migration

				
									By Amelia Jenne
				
			
		
		  
			
				Five European countries have announced plans to set up a migrant hub in Rwanda – where they want to send people whose asylum claims have been rejected.

Denmark’s prime minister Mette Frederiksen said it would be a “game changer” in confronting what she called the “massive challenges with illegal migration”.

Officials insisted the new return hubs would be run according to European and international law. But critics say deporting people to third countries would breach their human rights.
